description: Owners only (needs sign-in): When the owner asks (or, on an agent's own line, when the agent needs to), the business’s AI agent phones a US number from the business’s Latchbell number (or, with a country code like +44, any number the business’s paired Android phone can call, from that phone), says it is the business’s AI assistant, and does what purpose says. Write purpose as its full brief: who it calls and for whom, the goal and what counts as done, what it may share or agree to, what to do on voicemail or if they can't help, and any tone or language; never secrets or card numbers. Only people and businesses there is a real reason to call: never marketing, sales, surveys or robocalls. Calls are recorded. At most 3 calls a day to one number, up to 10 minutes each from the plan’s call minutes. Returns call_id while the phone rings; follow it with phone_call. A request repeated within 10 minutes returns the first call. Details: https://latchbell.com/docs/phone.md.

purpose.description: Instructions for the AI agent: who it calls, why, what to say or find out

to.description: The phone number to call: a US one, or one with its country code (+44 …) through the paired Android phone
